analyst.summary: Cholamandalam Financial Holdings owns stakes in the Murugappa Group's NBFC lending business and its general-insurance joint venture. Group-level profit and income are both growing at a healthy double-digit pace, driven mainly by the lending business, while the insurance arm's profit roughly halved this year on weaker underwriting results. The stock trades cheaply relative to its overall returns, partly reflecting the normal 'holding company discount' seen across Indian markets. We rate this a Hold: a strong core lending franchise wrapped in a structurally discounted holding-company structure, with one subsidiary currently underperforming.
